How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Central University of Kerala Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 17-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Central University of Kerala Medical Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Medical Officer post is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the MCI and have at least three years of working experience in a hospital attached to a Medical College or a Corporate Hospital. A postgraduate medical qualification is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer post is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will the candidates be selected for the Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Medical Officer position involves an initial email application followed by an interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages to be considered.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Medical Officer position will receive a salary of Rs. 2,170/- per day. This is a contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST, Women) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Medical Officer in the Central University of Kerala recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Medical Officer position?
faq.answer: The job type for this Medical Officer position is contractual. This means the appointment will be for a specific period as per the terms and conditions of the university.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is advisable to download and read it thoroughly before applying.
